Container.Name: cartographarr
Container.Overview:
Where your Plex library is watched from, and what is wrong with it. Reads Tautulli and Plex: a map of every play, live activity, rules that act on streams, shared account signals, reported problems, and a library view that says which files cause trouble and what to do about them.
Mount the directory holding your libraries if you want to tidy a file's tracks (subtitles, audio, containers): the app finds each library underneath it. Everything else works without it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The port the interface answers on. 6277 spells MAPS on a phone keypad and is clear of the usual self-hosted stack.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, the GeoIP files and uploaded branding live here, and the kept posters unless the poster cache below points somewhere else.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Rules that use a time of day go by this.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Where the app writes inside the container. Leave as it is unless you moved the appdata mount.

Config.Name: Poster cache
Config.Description: Where kept posters live on the host. A fast pool such as /mnt/cache/appdata/cartographarr/posters keeps pages of posters quick. Leave empty to keep them in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Poster folder
Config.Description: The poster cache path inside the container. Leave as it is unless you changed the container side of the mapping above.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The directory your libraries sit in, for example /mnt/user/data/media. The app looks for each library underneath it, by name where the names match and by the files themselves where they do not, and says what it found under Settings, Library and files.

Config.Name: Media (second)
Config.Description: A second place libraries live, if they are split across shares or pools. A remote share works here too, at its path under /mnt/remotes, for example /mnt/remotes/SERVER_SHARE/media. Leave empty if everything is in one place.
